title: Keyframe / MapPoint Graph with shared_ptr + weak_ptr
hints: Ownership graph: Map → Keyframe (shared), Map → MapPoint (shared), Keyframe → MapPoint (shared), MapPoint → Keyframe (WEAK). No strong cycle, so dropping the map frees everything.
Live observers: `for (auto& w : mp->observers) if (auto kf = w.lock()) ...`. Never dereference a weak_ptr without lock().
pruneObservations: erase-remove with `[](const std::weak_ptr<Keyframe>& w) { return w.expired(); }` on each map point, summing size differences.
removeMapPoint: lock each observer and erase the point from its `points` vector BEFORE erasing it from the map. Then the last owner goes away and MapPoint::live drops.
